caption: The drawing depicts a detailed sketch of a child's dress in the left half, with puffed short sleeves, a high waist, and vertical panels of lace or decorative trim down the front and at the hem, rendered in shades of gray pencil. Above the dress, an arrow marks the sleeve width as "SLEEVE 21." On the right side of the composition, four horizontal rectangular bands show different intricate lace or embroidery patterns, each labeled with measurements along the right side. The bands display a variety of floral and leaf motifs, each with scalloped edges or ornate borders. Below the main dress on the left, there's a simple sketch of a short-sleeved blouse or undergarment with gathered neckline and sleeves, also shaded in gray. The entire composition is set against a cream or off-white plain background.
title: Christening Robe
